Elise v1.0.6 adds compatibility with both node sections in phungvanquy/v2board-new and improves logging for production use.

- New installations default to `v2board` for unified **V2Node** nodes. Use `--panel-type=v2board-uniproxy` for the separate protocol node sections. Both modes use the panel's supported config, users, traffic, and online-IP APIs without unsupported status/report requests.
- Config caching, idle-node heartbeats, panel polling/reporting intervals, and reporting thresholds are supported. Invalid panel responses produce errors instead of silently starting a fallback listener.
- Runtime logs redact credentials, keep records on one line, and move routine connection/poll messages to debug. File logging now retains its writer through shutdown.
- Optional runtime and audit files rotate by size and day, with defaults of 10 MiB per file, 5 files per sink, and 7 days retention. Logging queues are bounded; failures and dropped records are reported. ClickHouse delivery uses bounded retries and checks HTTP responses.
- Systemd limits log bursts. Journal disk retention remains controlled by the host; ClickHouse retention must be configured on the database.

Install the latest stable release:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phungvanquy/elise/refs/heads/main/install.sh -o /tmp/elise-install.sh &&
sudo bash /tmp/elise-install.sh install
```

Upgrade an existing installation:

```bash
sudo elisectl update
elise --version
```

Updates restart active nodes and briefly interrupt connections. Existing explicit panel selections remain unchanged: set `type=v2board` or `type=v2board-uniproxy` in an instance's configuration to switch adapters. The latter also requires `panel_node_type` and a single node ID. Choose the mode matching the node's panel section; node IDs can overlap between sections.

Linux amd64 and arm64 archives include the binary, installer, management tools, and systemd template. Each archive has a SHA-256 checksum verified by the installer. To pin this release, use the bootstrap script under `refs/tags/v1.0.6` and pass `install v1.0.6`.

See the [installation and node setup instructions](https://github.com/phungvanquy/elise/blob/v1.0.6/README.md#installation) and [logging configuration](https://github.com/phungvanquy/elise/blob/v1.0.6/README.md#logs-and-debugging).
